edges.label: SRI held the science half of the remote viewing effort from 1972
edges.note: Puthoff and Targ began CIA-sponsored work at SRI's Artificial Intelligence Center in 1972 and continued with intelligence community funding until they left in the mid-1980s.

edges.label: The research was conducted at Menlo Park, California
edges.note: SRI International, founded 1946 by Stanford trustees and separated from the university in 1970, hosted the work at Menlo Park.

edges.label: The Sol Foundation operates from the Stanford orbit
edges.note: Garry Nolan of the Stanford School of Medicine co-founded the Sol Foundation with Peter Skafish; its symposia are the current academic venue for the subject.
